name: Idle
description: Screensaver, lock, display power-off and optional suspend after inactivity, with battery overrides (ext-idle-notify, honours idle inhibitors and the idle-off/screensaver-off flags); bar indicator while Stay Awake is on

screensaverAfter.description: Seconds of inactivity before the screensaver starts (0 = never; ignored when not before lockAfter)

lockAfter.description: Seconds of inactivity before lock (0 = never)

dpmsAfter.description: Seconds of inactivity before displays turn off (0 = never)

suspendAfter.description: Seconds of inactivity before the machine suspends through haseen system suspend (0 = never). Always waits while an app holds an idle inhibitor or Stay Awake is on

onBattery.description: Overrides while on battery (UPower onBattery): any of screensaverAfter, lockAfter, dpmsAfter, suspendAfter in seconds; a missing or null key keeps the value above

respectInhibitors.description: Do nothing while an app holds an idle inhibitor (video, presentation)

debugIpc.description: Debug: expose the haseen.idle IPC target (state) for smoke tests
